jobs.title: Linux Platform Developer
jobs.description:
Vill du utveckla och integrera robusta Linuxplattformar för komplexa system i en teknikintensiv och teambaserad miljö? Här får du arbeta nära produkter och system där stabila, säkra och effektiva runtimeplattformar är avgörande. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera Linuxutveckling, systemintegration och automatisering i ett erfaret agilt team. Om rollen Utveckla och vidareutveckla Linuxbaserade plattformar.
  
  
Arbeta nära komplexa system i en teknikintensiv miljö. Bidra inom både utveckling, integration och verifiering. Samarbeta med konstruktörer, utvecklare och testfunktioner. Det här kommer du göra Utveckla funktioner för runtimeplattformar och systemnära mjukvara.
  
  
Integrera, konfigurera och verifiera mjukvara i systemmiljöer. Automatisera infrastruktur, byggflöden och leveranser. Arbeta med nätverk, säkerhetskritisk mjukvara och virtualisering. Delta i teamets planering och tekniska problemlösning.
  
  
Vi söker dig som har Erfarenhet av Linuxutveckling och systemnära mjukvara. Kunskap om nätverk, routing och brandväggar. Erfarenhet av automatisering, DevOps och CI/CD-flöden. Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i komplexa tekniska miljöer.
  
  
Intresse för både utveckling, integration och verifiering. Teknik & Verktyg Linux OS, servrar och driftmiljöer. Python, Bash, PowerShell och Bourne shell. Ansible, Kubernetes och Docker.
  
  
Golang, C# och C++. Virtualisering, nätverk och webbutveckling. Praktisk information Ort: Göteborg. Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat.
  
  
**Språk:** Svenska och engelska.

jobs.title: Senior C#/.NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Utveckla mjukvara för fordonskommunikation och fjärrfunktioner i ett erfaret agilt team i Göteborg. Vill du utveckla lösningar som kopplar samman fordon, verktyg och fjärrfunktioner genom hela produktlivscykeln? Här får du en senior roll i ett agilt team som bygger robusta och återanvändbara mjukvarulösningar för fordonsnära kommunikation. Om rollen Arbeta med kommunikationsgränssnitt mellan fordon, verktyg och fjärrfunktioner.
  
  
Bidra till produkter som används inom utveckling, test, produktion, verkstad och fjärrscenarier. Ta en senior teknisk roll i ett självorganiserande Scrum-team. Det här kommer du göra Designa, implementera och testa mjukvarulösningar i C# och .NET Core. Driva leveranser från lösningsdesign till support och acceptanstest.
  
  
Samarbeta nära intressenter för att skapa gemensamma och återanvändbara lösningar. Utveckla och vidareutveckla lösningar för mobil och plattformsoberoende användning. Bidra till kvalitet, automatisering och kontinuerlig förbättring i teamets leverans. Vi söker dig som har Gedigen och senior erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling i C# och .NET Core.
  
  
Erfarenhet av mobilutveckling med MAUI, Xamarin, iOS eller Android. Kunskap om DevOps och flertrådad programmering. Vana att arbeta enligt Scrum och andra agila arbetssätt. Meriterande erfarenhet av diagnostiska kommunikationsprotokoll och molnintegration.
  
  
Teknik & Verktyg C# och .NET Core MAUI, Xamarin, iOS och Android Visual Studio och Git DevOps och flertrådad programmering ISO 14229, SAE J1587, Azure och AWS Praktisk information Ort: Göteborg Arbetssätt: Ej specificerat Språk: Engelska

jobs.title: Backend Developer, Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
**Are you a backend developer who enjoys building reliable integrations and delivering scalable solutions? Are you motivated by taking ownership of your projects from development to deployment?**

Then you could be the one we are looking for to help build the integrations that connect JACK & JONES, VERO MODA and ONLY with leading marketplaces such as Amazon and Zalando! We offer the opportunity to work in a quality-driven environment with plenty of opportunities for professional development and technical challenges.

**THE DEPARTMENT**  
Brand Tech is a dynamic e-commerce department with the ambition of making our brands the preferred fashion choice across both our own webshops and external marketplaces. You will join an in-house team of experienced frontend and backend developers working closely together to deliver robust digital solutions across brands.  
You will become part of an international environment where collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are central to the way we work.

**THE JOB**  
As part of the Partner Team, you will develop and maintain the backend connectors that integrate our brands with marketplaces such as Amazon, Zalando and other partners. Your focus will be on building reliable, scalable integrations that ensure accurate and efficient data exchange.  
Working in a data-driven environment, you will help ensure that product information, stock levels and pricing flow seamlessly between our internal systems and external marketplace platforms.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Developing and maintaining APIs and marketplace connectors
* Ensuring stable synchronisation of product data, stock and pricing
* Onboarding new marketplace partners
* Optimising integrations and data flows across systems
* Taking ownership of projects from implementation to deployment.

**YOUR PROFILE**  
You're motivated by solving technical challenges and enjoy building reliable, scalable solutions. You're curious by nature, enjoy learning new technologies and value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You like working closely with your teammates and seeing your work through from development to deployment.

We care more about your curiosity, technical skills and genuine interest in software development than ticking every box. What matters most is that you:

* Have experience with .NET / C#
* Have experience working with XML and JSON
* Communicate well and enjoy collaborating across teams
* Speak and write English fluently

Experience with one or more of the following is an advantage:

Marketplace or e-commerce APIs (e.g. Amazon SP-API, Zalando Partner Program (zDirect), Tradebyte or Channable)

* Kubernetes
* Jira, GitHub and GitHub Actions
* Unit and integration testing
* Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers
* Datadog
* Microservice architecture
* Event-driven integrations and message queues (e.g. Google Pub/Sub or Amazon SQS).

**WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU**  
**I**f you have any questions regarding the position, feel free to contact Rasmus Skjoldborg Jørgensen +45 82 38 21 56. Otherwise, please send your application and CV along with relevant examples of your skills and previous projects no later than 30 October 2026.

**WORKPLACE:** Brande Denmark.

**ABOUT BESTSELLER**  
*At BESTSELLER, we are more than 20,000 people in 38 different countries working for over 20 fashion brands such as JACK & JONES, SELECTED, VERO MODA, ONLY, PIECES, VILA, OBJECT, MAMALICIOUS, NAME IT, NOISY MAY and Y.A.S. We are a family-owned company with a strong foundation and values to build on, empowering us to pursue the ideas we believe in to take BESTSELLER forward. We are committed to diversity and provide equal opportunities for everyone, irrespective of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strive to create an empowering environment where people can thrive and develop. For more information, visit www.bestseller.com.*

jobs.title: Quantitative Developer
jobs.description:
QCP is Asia's leading digital asset partner, empowering clients to seamlessly integrate digital assets into their portfolios.

We offer a comprehensive range of solutions - from spot on/off ramping and fixed income strategies to vanilla options and bespoke exotics.

Driven by the vision to be the most trusted partner in digital asset markets, we provide innovative solutions that make digital assets a core component of every portfolio, balance sheet, and treasury.

Since our founding in 2017, we have witnessed the potential of digital assets to transform financial markets and the world at large. We exist at the centre of change, successfully navigating three market cycles and bridging institutional and crypto ecosystems.

We work to build trusted partnerships, putting client success and care at the heart of everything that we do.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain components of our trading systems and supporting infrastructure, across execution and order management, exchange connectivity, market data, pricing and risk, and backtesting
* Work alongside traders, quants and portfolio managers to understand what they need and build it
* Write high-quality, maintainable, and efficient code, and learn from thorough code review
* Develop and debug software in a Linux environment
* Help investigate and resolve production issues, with support from the wider team
* Make good use of modern tooling, AI coding agents, and development practices
* Collaborate with team members in a fast-paced environment with daily deployments
* Take on additional engineering tasks as required by the team

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Financial Engineering, graduating soon or with up to two years of experience
* Strong programming ability in at least one of Java, Python, C# or Rust; we are open to candidates from any language background who can pick things up quickly
* Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms
* A working grasp of threading models and concurrency
* Evidence that you can build things and finish them, whether through internships, open-source contributions, coursework or your own projects
* Genuine enthusiasm for agentic development and working alongside AI coding agents
* An interest in trading and financial markets, however it has come about
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-moving environment

  
**Benefits**

The Environment We Offer

As a growing firm with a tightly-knit team, we respect and listen to all our employees. You will get the chance to make an impact by having your voice heard by everyone, including the management.

Our employees enjoy a high level of autonomy at work. We focus on substance, not form - as long as you can perform, you will be recognized and rewarded. We are also dedicated to supporting our staff and ensuring they develop holistically to maximize their potential in the long- term.

We also provide flexible working arrangement as required and a casual and fun environment to boot!

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Developer (IT-CA-2026-236-GRAE)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Are you passionate about software development and interested in supporting Open Data and Open Science in research? Join our team that is building services for open data and reproducible computational data analyses!

**Your responsibilities**

As a full-stack developer in our team, you will:

* Participate in the development of the REANA reproducible analysis platform allowing to run containerised declarative analysis workflows.
* Participate in the development of the LHCb Ntupling service allowing researchers to request custom open data from the LHCb experiment.
* Collaborate closely with LHC experimental physics teams working on open data and reproducible research.
* Collaborate with external institutes and partners working on open data, open science and reproducible analysis infrastructures.

**Your profile**

* Experience in full-stack software development and with frontend and backend software engineering technologies.
* Experience with container technologies and application deployment, monitoring and security.
* Some familiarity with basic principles of computational research data analyses would be a plus.

Skills

* Frontend technologies: React.
* Backend technologies: Python, Go.
* Deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* **By the application deadline,** you have a **maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation** in Computer Science or equivalent (or a related field) **and** **your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree**.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
* Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
* Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

  
**Additional Information**

Job closing date: **25.10.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**

Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.

Working hours: 40 hours per week

Job flexibility: Hybrid

Target start date: 01-December-2026

This position involves:

* Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
* Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Job reference: IT-CA-2026-236-GRAE

Field of work: Information Technologies

Benchmark job: 200020 - Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On-the-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.

Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.

If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**
